# Vendored third-party sources

## `ml-dsa/` (RustCrypto ML-DSA / Dilithium, FIPS 204)

- **Upstream:** [RustCrypto/signatures — `ml-dsa`](https://github.com/RustCrypto/signatures/tree/master/ml-dsa)  
- **License:** Apache-2.0 OR MIT (see `LICENSE-*` in that directory).

This tree is a **snapshot** of the upstream crate for reproducible experiments. Small **local patches** are documented in git history (e.g. helpers for ZKP witness generation).

Prefer syncing from upstream periodically rather than diverging long-term.
